name: Sophia (The Sophia)
headline: Shea Properties developed The Sophia, 158 new one- and two-bedroom apartments for adults 55 and older at 60% AMI in a six-story building in the Meridian International Business Center in unincorporated Douglas County (Englewood address), with a 2023-cycle federal 4% credit and Douglas County Housing Partnership bonds; it is now leasing.
why_it_matters: A private developer's senior 4% deal in a suburban office park, financed with bonds issued by the county's housing partnership; it adds 158 income-restricted homes for older adults near I-25 and E-470.

status.label: Construction started 2024; now leasing (October 2026)
status.detail: JHL Constructors announced the start of construction on 2024-04-30 with completion scheduled for summer 2025. As of 2026-10-21 Shea's property page describes a 55+ affordable community now leasing at 9696 Maroon Circle. No certificate of occupancy date was found, and the deal is still on CHFA's 4% award report (no 8609s issued).

next_step: Watch for 8609 issuance (move to CHFA's 4% Completed Developments Report) and lease-up.

background.text: The Douglas County Housing Partnership issued Series 2024 multifamily housing revenue notes for The Sophia, reported by bond counsel in March 2024, for a senior 55+ affordable facility of about 158 units on about 8.4 acres northeast of Meridian Boulevard and the western end of Maroon Circle.
JHL Constructors began construction with Shea Properties and Galloway in spring 2024, scheduling completion for summer 2025.
The deal does not appear in CHFA's 2023 Round One or Round Two applicant reports or the 2023 Round Two award report.
